verifiedFacts.massConvention: Base curb includes standard equipment and full fuel, lubricant and coolant; does not isolate optional NV244 mass. Front+rear printed values total4697lb vs4696lb curb.

fidelityLimits: Fixed normal AWD high range only. Existing AWD model uses open center(lock0),52percentrear and open axle differentials. This represents normal full-time mode; it does not reproduce selectable4HI/4LO/neutral, driveline wind-up or exact transfer-case dynamics. No new controls or global systems added.
545RFE upshift ladder used. Alternate1.50 second-gear kick-down path is not separately modeled; existing torque-converter behavior is generic. No fictitious manual gearbox.

4696lb reference curb is the published base Quad Cab SLT4WD5AT value, used as a simulation baseline; exact NV244-equipped option weight is unverified. Front distribution derived2750/(2750+1947), acknowledging one-pound table discrepancy.
